transcript: Speaker A: Mujhe English bilkul nahi... [I don't know English at all...] Speaker B: ...aati, uske liye hi toh main hoon! Mera naam Disha hai aur main English Seekho app par sikhane ke liye taiyaar hoon. Subah paanch baje ho ya raat ke barah baje, bolkar message record karke bhejo, main jawab dungi. Galat bologe, sudhar dungi. Sau baar galat bologe, sau baar sudhar dungi. Toh apni speed par, apne time par, jab man kare tab seekho. Jab tak bolna nahi aaye, tab tak mere saath practice karo. [..know, that's what I'm here for! My name is Disha and I am ready to teach on the English Seekho app. Whether it's 5 AM or 12 midnight, record and send a voice message, I will reply. If you speak wrong, I will correct you. If you speak wrong a hundred times, I will correct you a hundred times. So learn at your own speed, at your own time, whenever you feel like it. Until you learn to speak, practice with me.] Speaker A: Par bolna kya hai, yeh kaise aayega? [But what to speak, how will that come?] Speaker B: App par experts ke videos hain, chhote aur mazedaar. Hindi mein samjha ke English sikhate hain. Chhote do se paanch minute ke videos, itne aasaan ki lagega yeh toh mujhe bhi aa jayega. Pehle woh video dekho aur phir jo seekha hai, mere saath chat par practice karo. Grammar ka ratta lagane se English nahi aayegi. Roz bolne wale sentences seekhogi, kahan aur kab kya bol sakti ho woh seekhogi toh English bol paogi. Agle chaudah din roz sirf pandrah minute lagatar yeh karo, yeh mahina khatam hote-hote tum English bol rahi hogi. English seekhna mushkil nahi hai, mushkil hai shuru karna. Chaudah din mein perfect nahi hogi, jhooth nahi bolungi, par itna ho jayega ki tum bol paoge bina ruke, bina dare, bina sharmaye. Trial sirf ek rupaye. Ab bahane nahi, sirf practice. Toh install button par click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [There are expert videos on the app, short and fun. They explain in Hindi and teach English. Short two to five-minute videos, so easy that you'll feel even I can do this. First watch that video and then practice what you learned with me on chat. You won't learn English by rote learning grammar. If you learn daily-use sentences, where and when to say what, then you will be able to speak English. Do this for just 15 minutes daily for the next 14 days, and by the end of this month, you will be speaking English. Learning English is not difficult, starting is difficult. You won't be perfect in 14 days, I won't lie, but it will be enough that you can speak without stopping, without fear, without shyness. Trial for just one rupee. No more excuses, only practice. So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.] Speaker C: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: An AI avatar named Disha encourages a young woman struggling with English to practice speaking on the English Seekho app. She highlights features like 24/7 voice message practice, expert video lessons in Hindi, and a 14-day challenge.
